note: Single machine-readable source of truth for every public technical claim about citrate-chain. Each value is tied to source files and, where applicable, reproducible evidence. Website and marketing facts MUST be generated from this file, not hand-copied. Numbers here were measured/derived from the code at source_commit; see verification_status per claim. See verification/README.md for status definitions.

salt_total_supply.unit: whole SALT (base tokens; multiply by 10^decimals for wei)
salt_total_supply.notes: Code comment: scaled 1000x from a former 1B cap at the 2026-09 reroll. TOTAL_SUPPLY is the single source of truth; TokenConfig::default and GenesisConfig::validate derive the wei cap from it. Any 1-billion figure on public surfaces is stale.

chain_id.notes: Testnet and mainnet configs both pin 40204. 40204 == 0x9d0c.

ghostdag_k.notes: GhostDAG blue-set anticone bound k = 18, consumed by core/consensus/src/ghostdag.rs via GhostDagParams.

block_time.notes: Config parser requires an integer number of seconds; the config comment records a whitepaper 500ms target. Testnet runs at 1s. (Legacy testnet-config.toml at repo root uses block_time=2.)

checkpoint_interval.notes: [checkpoint] interval=50, committee_size=100, quorum_threshold=67 (2/3+1 BFT committee finality, WP-W.2).

deterministic_checkpoint_finality.reproduction_command: sed -n '48,53p' node/config/testnet.toml  # interval*block_time = 50*1s ~= 50s to a BFT checkpoint
deterministic_checkpoint_finality.notes: Deterministic BFT finality is reached at the next checkpoint: interval(50 blocks) x block_time(1s) ~= 50s worst case, ~25s average. State is never reverted below the last finalized checkpoint (invariant I4). The '~25-50s' public figure derives directly from these two config values.

confirmation_latency.notes: Probabilistic confirmation is one block (~1s); deterministic BFT finality lands at the next checkpoint (~25-50s). Finality depth bound is 100 blocks. No end-to-end measured latency artifact is published yet.

foundry_tests.count_method: forge test --use 0.8.36 final summary line ('2913 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped')
foundry_tests.notes: Measured on forge 1.5.1-stable at source_commit. 158 test suites, 2913 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped.

rust_tests.count_method: cargo test --workspace -- --list | grep -c ': test' (each ': test' line is one #[test]/#[tokio::test] case). The per-binary 'N tests' summary lines sum to the same 4379, cross-checking the count.
rust_tests.notes: 4379 unit/integration test cases across the workspace, measured at source_commit (whole workspace compiled clean, exit 0). Doctests are NOT included (cargo --list does not enumerate them). Marketing surfaces have quoted 5,377 and 6,720 Rust tests; DO NOT copy those — 4379 is the measured figure. (Static grep of #[test]/#[tokio::test] annotations gives ~4,696, an upper-ish approximation that miscounts cfg-gated/macro-generated cases.)

deployed_contracts.count_method: len(contracts)=69 + len(aaStack)=7 = 76 deployed application/AA contracts on chain 40204 (the public '76+' claim). genesis.ArachnidDeterministicDeployer (1) and two top-level entries (CitrateMemberSBT, MembershipStakeVault) are tracked separately.
deployed_contracts.notes: 40204.json is the canonical address table (deployedAt 2026-09-12). The '76+' figure = 69 app contracts + 7 AA-stack contracts.

precompiles.notes: Canonical scheme (WP-B0): the EVM address IS the documented short name. ModelDeploy=0x0100, ModelInference=0x0101 per the dispatcher and 40204.json. FLAG: contracts/src/ModelRegistry.sol:17-18 hardcodes MODEL_PRECOMPILE=0x...1000 and ARTIFACT_PRECOMPILE=0x...1002, which DISAGREE with the canonical inference family (0x0100-0x0106). ModelRegistry's precompile calls therefore target 0x1000/0x1002, addresses outside the pure-precompile set and not present in 40204.json. Tracked as a discrepancy to reconcile.

model_registry_precompile_flag.notes: DISAGREEMENT CONFIRMED. ModelRegistry.sol calls address 0x1000 (=4096) / 0x1002, but the canonical model precompiles live at 0x0100/0x0101. 0x1000 is not a registered pure precompile in the dispatcher nor in 40204.json's precompiles table.

network_tps.reproduction_command: cargo bench -p citrate-execution --bench tps_parallel  # executor ceiling; canonical live-network harness: tools/citrate-bench (signs client-side via eth_sendRawTransaction)
network_tps.notes: The cited artifacts benchmarks/benchmark_2026_03_20.md and benchmarks/parallel_tps_verified_2026_04_21.md DO NOT EXIST in the repo. 5000 sustained / 10000 ceiling is a March-2026 baseline recorded in CLAUDE.md, not currently reproducible from a committed artifact. The 773K tx/s @ 8 workers is an in-process executor microbench (tps_parallel.rs), NOT a live-network number. benchmark_suite.rs is explicitly DEPRECATED for release claims (uses fake unlocked sender on devnet); the canonical harness is tools/citrate-bench. Re-run + committed artifact pending.

tla_specs.reproduction_command: gh repo clone CitrateNetwork/citrate-agentile-archive && find citrate-agentile-archive/formal/specs -name '*.tla' | wc -l
tla_specs.count_method: find formal/specs -name '*.tla' | wc -l (in the PUBLIC citrate-agentile-archive repo)
tla_specs.notes: 169 authored .tla specs measured in the archive at HEAD. Partial: a subset carry recorded TLC model-check runs; the largest cit-agent specs are bounded, not exhaustively verified. Marketing decks say 121-122 specs (stale/undercount vs the 169 authored today) and should be regenerated from this count.

transaction_signing_flow_states.notes: 73M distinct states explored for TransactionSigningFlow (PRODUCT_SPEC.md table, diameter 10). This is the authoritative figure; the '50B' figure sometimes cited is NOT supported by the archive and must not be used.

evm_revm.notes: EVM execution via revm pinned to exact version =10 (default-features off; std + serde). Adapter in src/revm_adapter.rs.

consensus_ghostdag.notes: GhostDAG (Kaspa-family) blue-set consensus with k=18, VRF leader election (strict_vrf=true), and a BFT checkpoint committee (size 100, quorum 67) for deterministic finality.

audit_status.notes: Classified Tier 1 (full external audit required before first stable v1.0.0 tag). No written external-firm audit attestation exists yet; internal adversarial re-audits and cargo-audit tripwires are in place. Prerelease tags may ship with a prerelease flag + warning.
